artifacts.notes: One page image, 2250 by 3791 pixels, of leaf n264, which is PL 30 cols. 521-522, running head 'LIBER COMITIS'. One opening only, not the volume: a negative read off it is an absence from these two columns and from nothing wider. It carries the Liber Comitis entry that pairs this Sunday's Epistle and Gospel and cuts both at the verses the 1962 book cuts them at, while heading the day 'Dominica mensis vi'.
artifacts.rights_basis: Mechanical reproduction of one page of a pre-1930 printing; the underlying publication is in the public domain in the United States, and the faithful photographic reproduction adds no original authorship, originality being required by Feist Publications, Inc. v. Rural Telephone Service Co., 499 U.S. 340, 345 (1991). The bytes are therefore retained here under the project-wide retention default, so that a reader with no network can reopen the page a claim rests on.

edition.title: Patrologiae cursus completus, Series Latina, Tomus XXX: S. Hieronymi tomus undecimus

work.author: Jacques-Paul Migne, publisher and series editor
work.description: Volume 30 of Migne's Patrologia Latina, the eleventh Migne volume of Jerome, printing the Opera supposititia: works transmitted under Jerome's name that its own editorial preface holds not to be his. The Liber Comitis, the early Roman epistle-and-gospel list that Migne prints among these spuria, stands at cols. 487-532. A container volume: its constituent works keep their own identities and are not reassigned to Migne or to Jerome.
work.title: Patrologiae cursus completus, Series Latina, volume 30
